core: Dolichol-linked N-glycan and GPI anchor biosynthesis
name: Dolichol-linked N-glycan and GPI anchor biosynthesis defects
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar and dolichol precursor synthesis, lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, N-glycan processing and GPI anchoring with their CDG defects, whereas confusables centre on sialic acid, UDP-GlcNAc transport and glucuronate metabolism.

name: Selective autophagy, microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy
rationale: All members concern cargo-selective autophagy (aggrephagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, receptor mitophagy, nuclear microautophagy, CMA) and autophagosome assembly control, unlike confusables focused on PINK1-PRKN mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics or aggresome protein quality control.

name: ERBB4 homo- and heterodimer signaling, including nuclear ERBB4
rationale: Members describe ERBB4 homodimer and ERBB2/ERBB3 heterodimer signaling, its PI3K arm, nuclear signaling and downregulation, whereas confusables cover PTK6, EGFR, ERBB2 and MET signaling.

name: BAF (SWI/SNF) chromatin remodeling complex assembly
rationale: All members are formation of the cell-type and variant BAF SWI/SNF complexes, distinct from confusables on CHD remodelers, histone acetylation and apoptotic chromatin breakdown.

name: Mitochondrial protein presequence processing and degradation
rationale: Members concern signal-peptide processing of mitochondrially targeted proteins and mitochondrial proteolysis, while confusables cover protein import, membrane insertion, cristae formation or MCU/SMDT1 calcium regulation.

qualifier: endocrine, exocrine and lymphoid glands and trachea
name: Endocrine, exocrine, lymphoid gland and trachea organogenesis
rationale: Members are development of thyroid, parathyroid, thymus, spleen, salivary, lacrimal and mammary glands, bile duct and trachea, whereas confusables are craniofacial, palate, ear and limb development.

qualifier: adhesion receptors, agonist receptor signaling and degranulation
name: Platelet adhesion, agonist receptor activation and degranulation
rationale: Members span VWF/GPIb and GPVI collagen adhesion, thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling and granule release, unlike confusables on the coagulation protease cascade, G12/13-Rho signaling or integrin-cytoskeleton modules.

name: Transcriptional co-regulation by NuRD/CHD remodelers and SUMOylation
rationale: Members involve chromatin co-regulators (NuRD, CHD6-9, ChAHP, arginine methyltransferases, Polycomb/CTCF modules, SUMOylated cofactors) controlling target genes such as PTEN and PD-L1, whereas confusables emphasise BAF assembly, histone acetylation, DNA methylation and retroelement silencing.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum and cytosolic calcium cycling
name: Sarcoplasmic and cytosolic calcium cycling in striated muscle
rationale: Members cover ryanodine-receptor release, SR calcium uptake, store-operated entry, Na/Ca exchange and their control of cardiac and skeletal contraction, whereas confusables emphasise chemical regulation of heart contraction, potassium/action potential control or gap-junction conduction.

name: Sulfur amino acid catabolism with PLP and molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine and sulfide catabolism and the vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors these enzymes require, unlike confusables on tetrahydrobiopterin, selenium, or serine and proline metabolism.

name: Intrinsic coagulation pathway factor VIII and IX defects
rationale: All members are defects of factor VIII or IX or the intrinsic pathway they drive (hemophilia A/B), whereas confusables cover VWF, FXII/kallikrein, factor V, fibrin and fibrinolysis.

name: Classical and alternative complement activation and regulation
rationale: Members describe classical and alternative complement activation and its positive and negative control, while confusables emphasise lectin pathway, C3/C5 convertase, opsonization or hypersensitivity.

name: Reactive gliosis and astrocyte activation and migration
rationale: Members concern glial activation, proliferation and migration in reactive gliosis with restraint of myelination, while confusables concern oligodendrocyte differentiation and myelin formation.

core: B cell proliferation, survival and homeostasis
name: B cell proliferation, survival and homeostasis, CD27 costimulation
rationale: Members regulate B cell proliferation, apoptosis, homeostasis and germinal center formation including CD27 signaling, whereas confusables centre on BCR signaling, B cell development or Tfh/ICOS-driven germinal center differentiation.

name: TGF-beta SMAD2/3 signaling and its negative regulation
rationale: Members describe TGF-beta receptor to SMAD2/3:SMAD4 transcription and its downregulation, whereas confusables cover cancer mutants, RUNX3 targets and TGFBR3/activin signaling.

qualifier: NEIL glycosylases and short/long-patch gap filling
name: Base excision repair with NEIL glycosylases and patch gap-filling
rationale: Members span damaged-base recognition and cleavage, AP site processing and short- and long-patch gap filling with NEIL1/NEIL3 defects, while confusables cover OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects or direct alkylation reversal and TET demethylation.

qualifier: and B cell development and activation
name: BCR signaling and B cell development and activation
rationale: Members cover antigen-BCR signaling (BTK, RAS, CD22 regulation) and B cell development and activation modules, whereas the nearest confusable centres on CD27, apoptosis and germinal center control and others are B cell-enriched expression modules.

name: Collagen, laminin and integrin interactions including VWF-collagen binding
rationale: Members concern basement membrane collagen and laminin assembly and integrin binding plus VWF variant binding to collagen and GPIb, unlike confusables on hemidesmosomes, collagen crosslinking or platelet activation.

name: Postsynaptic kainate and AMPA receptor activation and excitotoxicity
rationale: Members describe kainate and AMPA receptor activation in excitatory transmission and kainate-induced hippocampal neuron death, whereas confusables cover presynaptic kainate/G-protein effects, AMPA trafficking or NMDA receptor signaling.

qualifier: to Rho-family GTPases via ROBO, ephrin and DCC
name: ROBO, ephrin and DCC guidance signaling to Rho GTPases
rationale: Members describe SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and DCC receptor signaling acting on RAC1, CDC42 and RHOA, while confusables cover commissural pathfinding, L1 and netrin repulsion.

qualifier: RIP1-mediated, downstream of TNFR1 and TLR4
name: RIP1-mediated canonical NF-kB activation downstream of TNFR1 and TLR4
rationale: Members cover RIP1/linear-ubiquitin-dependent IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kB activation from TNFR1 and TLR4-TRIF, whereas confusables cover IRAK/TLR7-9 signaling and non-canonical NF-kB.

name: OGG1 8-oxoguanine glycosylase defects
rationale: All three members are OGG1 defects in localization, substrate binding and processing, distinct from confusables on other glycosylases and downstream BER steps.

name: Homology-directed DNA break end resection and single-strand annealing
rationale: Members cover DSB end processing, single-strand annealing and BRCA2-RAD51 impairment, whereas confusables cover NHEJ and DSB sensing or PALB2/BRCA1 HRR defects and SDSA.

name: DHA-, DPA- and EPA-derived pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis
rationale: All members are biosynthesis of resolvins, protectins and maresins from docosanoid/EPA precursors, while confusables concern arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs and leukotriene catabolism.

qualifier: epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and glands
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and gland branching morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, mesenchymal proliferation and bud branching of lung, trachea, salivary gland and limb bud, whereas confusables cover alveolar pneumocyte maturation, pancreatic/kidney lineages or prostate branching.
